title: Settings
showtrailHint: Makes the trail public, allowing any user to find it through search.
hidetrailHint: Makes the trail private, ensuring only members can see the trail.

delete.deleteCourseDescription: After deleting the trail, all tracks, photos, videos, files will be lost. You will no longer have access to any content from this trail. So please be sure before proceeding.
delete.deleteConfirmation: Do you really wish to delete the trail?
delete.deleteDescription: By deleting a trail you will lose all the content associated with it.
